```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(mgcv)
library(broom)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Data prep
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
# Convert StartTime text like "9:34 AM" or "1:15 PM" to decimal hours (24 h).
# Also handles 24 hour text like "13:15" (no AM/PM) and "9:34:00 AM".
to_hours <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_upper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  parts <- str_match(x, "^(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})(?::\\d{2})?\\s*([AP]M)?$")
  hr <- as.numeric(parts[, 2])
  mn <- as.numeric(parts[, 3])
  ampm <- parts[, 4]
  hr <- case_when(
    ampm == "PM" & hr < 12 ~ hr + 12,
    ampm == "AM" & hr == 12 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ hr
  )
  hr + mn / 60
}
 
# ---- 0a. Load and clean the raw files ------------------
landbird_raw <- read.csv("./Data/split_data.csv")
 
landbird <- landbird_raw %>%
  select(Date, Site, CommonName, Start.Time, Temperature....F., Comments) %>%
  rename(StartTime = Start.Time,
         Temp = Temperature....F.,
         date = Date) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
         Year = year(Date),
         Month = month(Date),
         Day = day(Date)) %>%
  select(Date, Year, Month, Day, Site:Comments)
 
crosswalk <- read.csv("./Data/SciCoName.csv")
 
landbird <- landbird %>%
  left_join(crosswalk, by = c("CommonName" = "Species")) %>%
  select(Date, Year, Month, Day, Site.x:Comments, CommonName.y, ScientificName) %>%
  rename(Site = Site.x,
         Species_Code = CommonName,
         CommonName = CommonName.y)
 
# ---- 0b. Derived columns for the analyses ------------------------------------
lb <- landbird %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species_Code)) %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),   # no-op if already a Date
    Year = year(Date),
    Month = month(Date),
    doy = yday(Date),   # day of year, used as the timing covariate
    survey_id = as.character(Date),
    start_hr = to_hours(StartTime),
    Temp = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Temp))
  )
 
spp <- lb %>%
  group_by(Species_Code) %>%
  summarise(CommonName = first(CommonName),
            ScientificName = first(ScientificName), .groups = "drop")
 
# Sanity checks on the crosswalk join (duplicate keys in the crosswalk would
# silently inflate detection counts)
cat("Rows with no crosswalk match:", sum(is.na(lb$ScientificName)), "\n")
no_time <- is.na(lb$StartTime) | lb$StartTime == "" |
  str_detect(str_to_lower(lb$StartTime), "no data")
cat("Rows with no StartTime recorded:", sum(no_time),
    "| rows with no Temp recorded:", sum(is.na(lb$Temp)), "\n")
cat("StartTime values that could not be parsed:",
    sum(is.na(lb$start_hr) & !no_time), "\n")
summary(lb$start_hr)   # should fall in a sensible field-day range
if (exists("landbird_raw")) {
  cat("Rows in raw data:", nrow(landbird_raw), "| rows after join:", nrow(lb), "\n")
}
 
# One row per survey (one row per date, sites pooled)
surveys <- lb %>%
  group_by(survey_id) %>%
  summarise(
    Date = first(Date), Year = first(Year), Month = first(Month),
    doy = first(doy),
    start_hr = mean(start_hr, na.rm = TRUE),   # mean across sites that day
    Temp = mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    detections = n(), richness = n_distinct(Species_Code),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
# Zero-filled survey x species matrix of detection counts
mat <- lb %>%
  count(survey_id, Species_Code) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species_Code, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("survey_id")
mat <- mat[surveys$survey_id, ]
 
# Quick data overview
cat("Surveys:", nrow(surveys), "| Species:", ncol(mat),
    "| Years:", min(lb$Year), "-", max(lb$Year), "\n")
surveys %>% count(Year, name = "n_surveys") %>% print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Effort through time (always check this first)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(surveys, aes(factor(Month))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~Year) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Surveys", title = "Survey effort by month and year")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Species accumulation curve (how complete is the species list?)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pa <- (mat > 0) * 1
acc <- specaccum(pa, method = "random", permutations = 200)
plot(acc, ci.type = "polygon", ci.col = "grey85", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Number of surveys", ylab = "Cumulative species",
     main = "Species accumulation")
 
# Chao2 / jackknife estimates of total richness
print(specpool(pa))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Rank abundance (Whittaker) plot: how dominated is the community?
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rank_ab <- lb %>%
  count(Species_Code, name = "n") %>%
  left_join(spp, by = "Species_Code") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number(), prop = n / sum(n))
 
ggplot(rank_ab, aes(rank, n)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey50") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(data = head(rank_ab, 10), aes(label = CommonName),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Rank", y = "Total detections (log10)", title = "Rank abundance")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Phenology heatmap: detections per survey by month, top species
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
top_spp <- rank_ab$Species_Code[1:25]
surv_per_month <- surveys %>% count(Month, name = "n_surveys")
 
pheno <- lb %>%
  filter(Species_Code %in% top_spp) %>%
  count(Species_Code, Month) %>%
  complete(Species_Code = top_spp, Month = sort(unique(lb$Month)),
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  left_join(surv_per_month, by = "Month") %>%
  left_join(spp, by = "Species_Code") %>%
  mutate(rate = n / n_surveys) %>%
  group_by(Species_Code) %>%
  mutate(peak = Month[which.max(rate)],
         rate_rel = rate / max(rate, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(CommonName = fct_reorder(CommonName, peak, .desc = TRUE))

ggplot(pheno, aes(factor(Month), CommonName, fill = rate_rel)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(x = "Month", y = NULL, fill = "Relative\ndetection rate",
       title = "Pattern across surveyed months, scaled within species")
 
# How consistently is each species detected across the surveyed months?
n_months <- n_distinct(lb$Month)
status <- lb %>%
  group_by(Species_Code) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), months_present = n_distinct(Month),
            years_present = n_distinct(Year), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(frac_months = months_present / n_months,
         status = case_when(frac_months >= 0.8 ~ "Most months",
                            frac_months >= 0.4 ~ "Some months",
                            TRUE ~ "Few months")) %>%
  left_join(spp, by = "Species_Code")
status %>% count(status)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Species level population trends (detections per survey, zero filled)
#    Quasi-Poisson with a day of year term; reported as % change per year
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
min_surveys_detected <- 30
common_spp <- names(which(colSums(mat > 0) >= min_surveys_detected))
 
fit_trend <- function(sp) {
  d <- surveys %>%
    mutate(n = mat[survey_id, sp], Year_c = Year - min(Year))
  fit <- glm(n ~ Year_c + doy, family = quasipoisson, data = d)
  tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "Year_c") %>%
    mutate(Species_Code = sp)
}
 
trends <- map_dfr(common_spp, possibly(fit_trend, otherwise = NULL)) %>%
  left_join(spp, by = "Species_Code") %>%
  mutate(pct = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
         lo = (exp(conf.low) - 1) * 100,
         hi = (exp(conf.high) - 1) * 100,
         sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "n.s."),
         CommonName = fct_reorder(CommonName, pct))
 
ggplot(trends, aes(pct, CommonName, color = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("p < 0.05" = "firebrick", "n.s." = "grey50")) +
  labs(x = "% change in detections per survey, per year", y = NULL,
       color = NULL, title = "Species trends")
 
# Raw annual detection rate for the biggest winners and losers
movers <- trends %>% arrange(pct) %>% slice(c(1:4, (n() - 3):n())) %>%
  pull(Species_Code)
 
annual_rate <- surveys %>%
  select(survey_id, Year) %>%
  bind_cols(as_tibble(mat[surveys$survey_id, movers])) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(movers), names_to = "Species_Code", values_to = "n") %>%
  group_by(Year, Species_Code) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(spp, by = "Species_Code")
 
ggplot(annual_rate, aes(Year, rate)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~CommonName, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "Mean detections per survey", title = "Biggest movers")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Diversity through time (rarefied so uneven effort does not bias it)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
year_mat <- lb %>%
  count(Year, Species_Code) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species_Code, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Year")
 
div <- tibble(
  Year = as.numeric(rownames(year_mat)),
  detections = rowSums(year_mat),
  observed_richness = specnumber(year_mat),
  rarefied_richness = as.numeric(rarefy(year_mat, sample = min(rowSums(year_mat)))),
  shannon = diversity(year_mat, "shannon"),
  evenness = diversity(year_mat, "shannon") / log(specnumber(year_mat))
)
print(div)
 
div %>%
  pivot_longer(c(rarefied_richness, shannon, evenness)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Year, value)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Annual diversity metrics")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. First and last detection records, and rare species
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
records <- lb %>%
  group_by(Species_Code) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), first_seen = min(Date), last_seen = max(Date),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(spp, by = "Species_Code") %>%
  arrange(n)
 
records %>% filter(n <= 3) %>% print(n = Inf)   # singletons and rarities
# Species not seen in the most recent 3 years that used to be regular
records %>%
  filter(n >= 20, last_seen < max(lb$Date) - years(3)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)




total_survey <- landbird %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Total_Surveys_In_Year = n_distinct(Date), .groups = "drop")

total_survey %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(Year), y = Total_Surveys_In_Year)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Total surveys") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = Total_Surveys_In_Year), vjust = -0.3)

total_survey <- landbird %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(Total_Surveys_In_Year = n_distinct(Date)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Date, CommonName, Total_Surveys_In_Year) %>%
  summarise(Daily_Count = n(), .groups = "drop")

landbird_summary<- total_survey%>%
  group_by(Year, CommonName)%>%summarise(
    TotalCountYearly = sum(Daily_Count),
    MeanCountPerSurvey = TotalCountYearly / first(Total_Surveys_In_Year),
    .groups = "drop")

landbird_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = MeanCountPerSurvey, color = CommonName, group = CommonName)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean count per survey",
    color = "Species",
    title = "Landbird mean count per survey by year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

top10 <- landbird_summary %>%
  group_by(CommonName) %>%
  summarise(Overall_Mean = mean(MeanCountPerSurvey, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_max(Overall_Mean, n = 10) %>%
  pull(CommonName)

#Average of yearly means (above) favors species that are consistently abundant. A species with one huge year and zeros elsewhere gets pulled down.

#Total across years: swap mean() for sum() if you want the species with the highest cumulative counts.

landbird_summary %>%
  filter(CommonName %in% top10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = MeanCountPerSurvey, color = CommonName, group = CommonName)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean count per survey",
    color = "Species",
    title = "Top 10 landbird species by mean count per survey"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

colnames(landbird)

```
